blogs.title: "Anemia’s Hidden Face – Detecting Short-telomeres Before Nutrient Corrections”
blogs.description: "Explains how severe vitamin B₁₂ loss can mask ineffective erythropoiesis caused by telomere erosion, shows lab clues (low reticulocytes despite DAT positivity), and outlines steps toward genetic testing when classic white‐space follows correction.

blogs.title: "Expanding PARN’s Portfolio – Monoallelic Variants Beyond Classical Dyskeratosis"
blogs.description: "Details why biallelic versus monoallelic PARN hits different phenotypes, reviews ACMG criteria applied to cys205arg VUS, highlights emerging links between heterozygous mutations and pulmonary fibrosis/hematologic failure.

blogs.title: "Fibroses From Liver To Lungs – The Multiorgan Spectrum Of Short‑Telomeres"
blogs.description: "Illustrates imaging findings (increased liver stiffness √ cirrhosis, ground‑glass inhalation), explains how stem‑cell exhaustion fuels hepatopulmonary scarring, recommends surveillance panels tailored to age‐related organ dysfunction.

blogs.title: "Managing Multi‑System Failure With Supportive Care Plus Transplant Options"
blogs.description: "Outlines strategies from vitamin replacement through hematology support toward curative allo‑stem cell transplantation and/or lung transplantation when indicated, discusses timing interdependence lightly tied to patient frailty scores.

blogs.title: "Interpreting a Variant Of Uncertain Significance – Counseling Steps For High Risk Families"
blogs.description: "Provides pragmatic guidance on discussing VUS findings during family counseling sessions—including penetrance estimation, cascade testing directives, surveillance schedules—and how clinicians decide action plans despite uncertainty.
